description: The offers the caller has placed on XP listings, as open or completed -- 'show my bids', 'did any of my offers settle?'. Rejected, lapsed and refunded offers are left out. Paged: 25 by default, up to 200 with limit, and offset to continue; pagination.total counts only the offers shown, and has_more marks further pages. Open offers resting across events are in list_my_open_offers. Requires sign-in.

limit.description: How many bids to return, 1-200. Defaults to 25.

offset.description: Skip this many. Use with limit to page.

name: get_my_offers
title: Get My Offers
